jobs.description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

Role Overview

Zuora is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to architect and scale our Agentic Deal Desk product. In this high-impact IC role, you will build resilient, high-throughput Java microservices alongside the underlying AI agent harness—the runtime scaffolding, execution loop, tool dispatch system, and state management engine that converts non-deterministic LLMs into reliable, enterprise-grade deal-desk agents.

Location & Work Arrangements

This role is based in our Foster City, CA office and follows a hybrid work model. Team members are expected to work onsite three days per week to foster collaboration, innovation, and team connectivity.

This is not a fully remote position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agent Harness Engineering: Build and own the core agent harness layer, including the execution loop (ReAct/Plan-Act), state persistence, dynamic prompt assembly, output schema validation, and retry mechanisms.
  • Tool Dispatch & Sandboxing: Design safe tool-execution runtimes and schema-validated function dispatchers that allow agents to execute complex deal operations, policy checks, and pricing adjustments securely.
  • Context & Memory Management: Engineer context compaction, short-term session scratchpads, and long-term memory retrieval pipelines (RAG/vector search) to eliminate context degradation during multi-turn deal negotiations.
  • Guardrails & Feedback Loops: Build computational and inferential feedback sensors (evaluators, deterministic policy linters, and verification checks) to enforce strict margin guardrails, discount limits, and compliance rules.
  • Backend Architecture: Design low-latency, event-driven Core Java microservices to back the harness, driving state transitions, audit logs, and integration with Zuora Billing and CRM platforms.
  • Technical Leadership: Set technical standards for agent harness design, drive evaluation/eval-driven development practices, and mentor senior engineers across squads.

Required Qualifications

  • Core Java Mastery: 8+ years of hands-on experience in modern Java (17+), JVM internals, concurrency models, Spring Boot, and cloud-native distributed architecture.
  • Agent Harness & Runtime Systems: Deep experience building the infrastructure surrounding LLMs—agent loops, state-machine tracking, tool calling/dispatch systems, context window management, and structured output parsing.
  • Agentic Frameworks & AI Tooling: Practical experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or custom in-house agent orchestration runtimes and vector databases (e.g., Pgvector, Pinecone).
  • Distributed Infrastructure: Heavy background in event-driven architecture (Kafka/RabbitMQ), high-performance caching (Redis), relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), and REST/gRPC API design.
  • Cloud & Runtime Security: Experience with AWS, Docker/container isolation, Kubernetes, and securing agent execution pathways against improper tool invocations or prompt injection.

Preferred Experience

  • AWS Agentic Enablement: Production experience leveraging Amazon Bedrock Agents (Action Groups, Knowledge Bases, Multi-Agent Collaboration) and Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock to enforce policy boundaries and tool permissions.
  • Serverless Agent Scaffolding: Experience utilizing AWS Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, and ECS/Fargate for isolated tool-execution environments, persistent session state checkpointing, and agent workflow orchestration.
  • AWS AI Observability & Evals: Familiarity with continuous agent monitoring, trace/span evaluation frameworks (e.g., Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, CloudWatch), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines for non-deterministic applications.
  • Domain Expertise: Experience in Enterprise Deal Desk operations, revenue operations, quote-to-cash workflows, dynamic pricing engines, or high-volume SaaS approval chains.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical Insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
  • Mental wellbeing resources and support

*Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora

ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:

  • Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
  • Learn constantly and iterate often
  • Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent, where applicable).

The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here.

Base Pay Details

$164,800—$226,600 USD

jobs.description:
Customer Success Associate (Sustainability)

Location: Remote (China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, or Philippines)

Reports to: Regional Lead, APAC

About Worldly

Worldly is the world's most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.

Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights into supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.

Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors.

About The Role

Worldly is seeking a Customer Success Associate to support the APAC Customer Success team across customer data operations, customer program delivery, training, and platform support. The role is responsible for managing customers' supplier lists and verifying data accuracy, supporting service cadences for customers in different subscriptions, delivering training to APAC customers, and handling platform/brand’s requirements enquiries. The role reports to the Regional Lead and works closely with other members of the Customer Success team across time zones.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working with large data sets, a confident communicator in front of customers, and interested in retail supply chains and ESG reporting.

What You'll Do

1. Customer data operations

  • Manage and maintain detailed record-keeping of customers' supplier lists; maintain and update supplier data by inputting text-based and numerical information from source documents within time limits on a recurring basis

  • Compile, verify accuracy, and sort information according to priorities to prepare source data for platform import

  • Review data for deficiencies or errors, correct any incompatibilities where possible, and check the output

  • Import data to the Worldly platform on behalf of customers

  • Send templated emails on behalf of customers

  • Store completed work in designated locations and perform backup operations

  • Respond to queries for information and access relevant files

2. Customer program & cadence support

  • Support facility list management, cadence setup & management, adoption emails, and reporting needs for ImpactService customers

  • Independent service delivery to customers in Platform Access subscription

  • Manage recurring customer deliverables (e.g., MWL updates) with CS Ninjas Team

  • Manage email cadences in HubSpot for customer adoption programs

  • Data / deck preparation for End-of-Cadence Meetings with assigned accounts

  • Consolidate and visualize platform data into presentation materials

3. Training & events

  • Deliver training sessions and host office hours for APAC customers

  • Manage training-related emails e.g., invitation and follow-up emails

  • Handle training/office hours follow-up: surveys, uploading recordings to the guidance site, collecting and answering Q&A, analyzing survey results

  • Report on training KPIs

  • Schedule training and office hours sessions in the CS Zoom account

  • Represent Worldly at industry events in APAC

4. Support & ticketing

  • Answer platform/brand’s requirements enquiries — deadlines, verification booking for Higg FEM and Higg FSLM, especially accounts-related

5. Translation & localization

  • Organize translation of training and guidance content

6. Team & workflow support

  • Assist Regional Lead in overseeing and shaping the CS Support Ninja workflow

  • Support onboarding, training & supervising CS Support Ninjas

  • Support UAT testing of (adoption, analytics, supply impacts)

  • Flexible to attend internal meetings in different time zones when required

We'd like To See

  • Large data handling experience (preferred)Proficiency in data management tasks utilizing tools like Excel, Google Sheets, etc.

  • Accuracy and attention to detail — essential

  • Propensity to problem-solve proactively and find solutions for potential problems or errors that have been identified

  • Ability to concentrate for lengthy periods and perform accurately with adequate speed

  • Confident presenter and communicator for customer-facing setup

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams

It Helps If You Have

  • Experience with HubSpot or other CRM technologies

  • Experience with Slack

  • 1+ years of technical SaaS environment product support experience

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Knowledge of retail supply chains

  • Interest in ESG reporting & similar with Higg Index Tools

  • Experience in customer service

  • Fluency in English plus a regional language (e.g. Mandarin, Vietnamese)

What We Can Offer You

  • Comprehensive benefits offerings. 100% employee premium covered by Worldly.

  • Growth Opportunities

  • Equipment Stipends

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Paid company holidays

Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we can build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

Benefits and perks

  • Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses; healthcare and retirement matching

  • Office stipend to get the supplies you need

  • Flexible time off — take the time you need to recharge; our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves

  • We're remote, not lonely — join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups

Travel Notice

​​Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.

Equity Statement

We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

Compensation

Annual Salary

  • $15,000 - $25,000 USD

Annual Bonus Plan

Work-From-Home Stipends

*Final compensation figures will be determined based on a wide variety of factors, including experience and location. These factors will be evaluated and considered by Worldly throughout the entirety of this process.

**For candidates located outside the U.S., the salary range listed in USD will be paid in the local currency equivalent at the time of offer using the then-current exchange rate.

jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You'll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs.

You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers, and design solutions that address the customer's needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers.

You will define the customer's financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp's technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features, and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer.

This role is specifically focused on Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise customers running SAP S/4HANA, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Technical Consultant for Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise accounts running SAP S/4HANA, supporting complex, high-impact customers with multi-entity, multi-ERP, and global financial environments

  • Act as a technical advisor to customers and Ramp's internal teams while supporting high-value implementations and expansion opportunities by guiding S/4HANA integration, configuration, and system design

  • Partner with Customer Activation and Account Management teams to assess customer requirements and propose scalable solutions involving S/4HANA, HRIS, and API integrations

  • Collaborate with onboarding specialists and implementation leads to support technical workstreams, ensuring faster time-to-value and customer success

  • Work with customers to problem-solve technical hurdles and propose effective product implementations with a deep understanding of S/4HANA integration and configuration options

  • Participate in technical discovery to understand customer S/4HANA environments and workflows, and recommend best-fit Ramp architecture including when and how to use Ramp's API

  • Be a subject matter expert across SAP S/4HANA and Ramp's accounting integration capabilities, partnering with Sales, Product and partners to advocate for integration development aligned with customer needs

  • Troubleshoot S/4HANA integration blockers and guide customers through complex configuration decisions

  • Contribute to internal documentation and tooling that scales Ramp's ability to support S/4HANA integration use cases across a growing customer base

  • Influence Ramp's product roadmap by channeling S/4HANA customer pain points and feedback to the Product and Engineering teams

What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, business, or a related field

  • 4+ years in technical consulting, solutions engineering, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally in a SaaS or fintech environment

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience working with SAP S/4HANA, including finance modules, integration patterns, and enterprise deployment models

  • Deep familiarity with S/4HANA finance and accounting workflows, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and cost center management

  • Comfort working with APIs, integration logic, and system architecture and being able to explain those concepts to finance and operations stakeholders

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design on enterprise-driven gaps, influencing roadmap decisions that unlock scale across Ramp's largest customers

  • Advise on non-standard S/4HANA implementations and edge cases, balancing customer needs with long-term platform scalability and supportability

  • Strong communication skills: able to translate complex technical solutions into business value and guide customers toward scalable approaches

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering

  • Exceptional organization and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward action and a high level of ownership

  • Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments; adaptable and resourceful as we scale Ramp's upmarket motion

HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Product Security Analyst

Remote Locations

- Boston, MA

- Austin, TX

- Washington, DC

- Seattle, WA

- San Francisco Bay Area, CA

Position Summary

HackerOne is a global leader in offensive security solutions. Our HackerOne Platform combines AI with the ingenuity of the largest community of security researchers to find and fix security, privacy, and AI vulnerabilities across the software development lifecycle.

As a Product Security Analyst, you will join HackerOne’s Technical Services organization and work directly with some of the world’s most skilled security researchers to help customers identify and remediate impactful vulnerabilities. You will play a critical role in validating, reproducing, and communicating security findings across bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure programs while helping maintain a high-quality experience for both customers and hackers.

As we continue evolving our AI-powered offensive security platform, this role offers an opportunity to deepen technical expertise in web and mobile application security while collaborating with globally distributed teams and the broader hacker community.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Boston MA, Austin TX, Washington DC, Seattle WA, or San Francisco Bay Area CA. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

What You Will Do

  • Evaluate vulnerability reports submitted by security researchers to determine validity, severity, exploitability, and business impact for HackerOne customers using Data-Driven Decision Making and established security frameworks such as CVSS.

  • Independently reproduce reported vulnerabilities across web and mobile applications, applying First Principles Problem Solving to validate findings, identify root causes, and clearly communicate impact.

  • Collaborate directly with security researchers to gather missing information, clarify technical details, and improve report quality while maintaining clear and professional communication with customers.

  • Create concise, technically accurate summaries for validated findings, including reproduction steps, impact analysis, and remediation guidance.

  • Demonstrate Change Agility by adapting to evolving customer environments, changing program scopes, emerging attack techniques, and shifting operational priorities.

  • Contribute to an AI-First approach by leveraging automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve operational efficiency, report analysis, and vulnerability triage quality.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Technical Services teammates and customer-facing teams to ensure timely handling of vulnerabilities and a high-quality customer experience.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve internal processes, documentation, tooling, and triage workflows to enhance scalability and consistency across the Technical Services organization.

  • Note: some weekend shifts will be required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience performing security testing, vulnerability research, or ethical hacking on web and mobile applications.

  • Strong technical understanding of common application security vulnerabilities, including the OWASP Top 10.

  • Experience using security testing tools such as Burp Suite and familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks including CVSS.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability and desire to work weekend shifts from time to time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience participating in bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs.

  • Experience reproducing and validating vulnerabilities submitted by external researchers or customers.

  • Familiarity with scripting or automation used in security testing or operational workflows.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and maintain operational excellence in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.

Tier B (all other locations) - $120,000 to $140,000 (+ equity)

About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

Location & Work Arrangements

This role is based in our Foster City, CA office and follows a hybrid work model. Team members are expected to work onsite three days per week to foster collaboration, innovation, and team connectivity.

This is not a fully remote position.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Engineer to join our backend engineering team. You’ll be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable services that power our enterprise-grade billing and revenue systems.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams — product managers, architects, and DevOps — to deliver critical features with high availability and performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable backend services using Java (11+), Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.
  • Build and maintain integrations with Kafka, AWS, and REST/gRPC APIs.

Required Qualifications

Nice-to-Have

Why Join Us

jobs.description:
Growth Marketer (6-Month Contract)

Location: Remote - US

About Worldly

Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.

Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.

Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story.

About The Role

Worldly is hiring a contractor to execute our growth marketing campaigns and report on how they perform. This is a hands-on execution role embedded in our marketing team. You take campaigns from brief to launch to results readout: you build the emails and HubSpot workflows, launch the LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns, set up the landing pages, QA everything, and pull the reports that tell us what worked.

You will also own answer engine optimization (AEO). Our buyers now do a lot of their research in tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and we want to know how Worldly shows up in those answers. You will measure it, track it over time, and run the plan to improve how often and how accurately we get cited.

This is a position for one person working with the marketing team. It is not a project for an agency or a consultancy, and it is not a fractional gig you fit in around other clients. If you would be subcontracting the work or bringing a team, this is not the right fit.

What You'll Do

Campaign execution

  • Execute campaigns end-to-end across paid, email, organic, events support, and content syndication, aimed at high-value accounts and buying committees in the consumer goods sector.

  • Do the hands-on work yourself: configure HubSpot workflows, launch and manage LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns, build landing pages, and QA every asset before it goes live.

  • Support account-based marketing (ABM) programs (1:many and 1:few) with our Growth (sales) team, targeting the decision-makers at the accounts sales cares about most.

  • Run a test-and-learn motion: launch small, measure, retire what is not working, and scale what is. Experiments need to show positive returns to earn a larger budget.

Campaign reporting and performance

  • Own campaign reporting and dashboards in HubSpot and Google Analytics, including attribution, lead quality, and pipeline contribution across the funnel (Lead, MQL, SAL, SQL).

  • Deliver a weekly performance readout to marketing and sales. Tell us plainly what is working, what is not, and where you would recommend we move the budget.

  • Keep campaign workflows and reporting infrastructure clean and reliable, with a clear marketing-to-sales handoff and feedback loop.

AEO: measure, track, and improve

  • Measure and track Worldly’s visibility in AI answer engines: how often we get cited, our share of voice against competitors, and how accurately Worldly (and the Higg Index, available through Worldly) is described.

  • Build and maintain an AEO scorecard, reported monthly, so we can see whether we are gaining or losing ground.

  • Develop and execute AEO improvement plans: content recommendations, page structure and schema changes, whatever makes Worldly content easier for AI engines to find and cite. You work with our content and web owners to actually ship the fixes.

We'd Like to See

  • 6+ years of hands-on B2B SaaS marketing execution, including demand generation and ABM campaigns you personally built, launched, and reported on.

  • Expertise in our stack: HubSpot (workflows, email, reporting), WordPress (website), LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Google Analytics. ABM platform experience (ZoomInfo) a plus.

  • Working knowledge of AEO/GEO: you have measured how brands show up in AI answer engines and improved it, or you are an experienced SEO practitioner who has extended into AI search and can show results.

  • Strong analytical and reporting habits. You are comfortable with pipeline metrics and attribution, and you can explain results to sales and marketing leaders without a glossary.

  • You have worked closely with sales teams before and delivered leads they actually wanted.

  • Fluent with AI tools and genuinely excited to experiment with them. You already use AI daily in your own marketing work.

  • Available full-time (roughly 40 hours per week) with overlap across U.S. and APAC business hours, based in the U.S., and able to work as an independent contractor.

Contract Details

  • Hours: 40 hours per week

  • Compensation: $75 - $100 hourly

  • Location: Remote

  • Contract Details: This role will start as a 6-month contract. Worldly reserves the right to end the contract with 30 days' notice. Depending on company strategy and performance, this contractor role has the potential to extend into a longer-term contract or convert to an FTE position.

Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

General Travel Notice

​​Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.

Equity Statement

We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As a Solutions Consultant at Ramp, you will play a crucial role in establishing and nurturing partnerships with potential customers. This involves building trust and confidence through expert demonstrations of Ramp's products and a deep understanding of our prospects' needs. Collaborating closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, and Account Management teams, you will prioritize and develop financial solutions for Ramp's key customers, ensuring that the product aligns with their evolving requirements. Acting as technical and financial experts, you will design integrated solutions, provide strategic advice to prospects, and facilitate communication between internal technical teams and prospects. Solutions Consultants drive customer success from deal evaluation to product activation, influencing product development to continually enhance Ramp's value proposition. This role requires strong technical skills, alongside strong presentation and value selling skills.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with Ramp Account Executives to showcase technical accounting features and benefits through customized product demos, workflow illustrations, and promoting Ramp’s value proposition

  • Develop tailored product solutions based on a deep understanding of integration and configuration options, ensuring effective alignment with customer needs

  • Partner with Sales, Product and Partners to advocate for integration development in-line with customer needs

  • Support Sales and Post-Sales teams in executing advanced technical and accounting implementations for Ramp

  • Evaluate customer requirements for new opportunities, determining Ramp's suitability through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical evaluations during customer discovery

  • Work alongside Product, Product Marketing, and Product Operations to create and maintain technical assets and an internal knowledge base of customer use cases and best practices

What You’ll Need

  • 2+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or similar customer-facing roles, focusing on implementing business SaaS solutions and utilizing APIs, preferably within the financial sector

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, finance, accounting or related field

  • Proficiency in IdP, HRIS, and/or ERP solutions

  • Expertise in accounting systems, controllership needs, and finance/accounting workflows

  • Exceptional organizational, project management, and time management abilities

  • Strong skills in engineering, system design, and technical specification writing

  • Proactive mindset, adaptability, and comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment

For candidates located in NYC or SF, the pay range for this role is $128,000 - $176,000. For remote candidates located in all other locations, the pay range for this role is $115,000-$159,000.

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Senior GTM Systems & Process Engineer

Remote Location: Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC

Position Summary

At HackerOne, our Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations function is modernizing and re-architecting the revenue engine, building an AI-native operating model that connects planning, opportunity management, forecasting, quoting, contracting, fulfillment, invoicing, analytics, and performance into a cohesive and scalable system.

We are looking for a Senior GTM Systems & Process Engineer to help design and scale the systems and processes that power our revenue organization. This role sits at the intersection of GTM process architecture, Salesforce administration, systems integration, and AI-enabled automation.

Reporting to the Head of GTM Operations, you will partner primarily with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and other GTM stakeholders to diagnose complex operational challenges and translate them into scalable technical solutions. You will work hands-on in Salesforce and across our GTM technology ecosystem, designing workflows, configuring systems, improving data flows, and deploying AI-enabled automations that make our revenue processes faster, smarter, and more reliable.

This is not an Apex development role, nor are we looking for a traditional Salesforce administrator focused solely on system maintenance. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Salesforce and revenue systems expertise with an understanding of how complex enterprise sales processes work from opportunity creation through forecasting, quoting, contracting, entitlements, and invoicing.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC.

What You Will Do

  • Architect and improve complex Salesforce workflows supporting opportunity management, pipeline management, forecasting, territory management, quoting, approvals, and other critical sales processes.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce expert, creating and maintaining fields, objects, flows, validation rules, approval processes, and other declarative configurations. Partner with developers when deeper Apex development or complex CPQ configuration is required.

  • Apply First Principles Problem Solving to diagnose complex GTM challenges, identify root causes, challenge legacy assumptions, and redesign processes and systems for scale.

  • Understand and optimize the end-to-end revenue process, including opportunity management, forecasting, quoting/CPQ, contracting, approvals, customer entitlements, downstream financial systems, and invoicing.

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable system and process designs.

  • Work with CPQ and quoting workflows, understanding how products, pricing, approvals, and quotes move through the revenue process. Deep development expertise in CPQ product rules, price rules, or discounting logic is not required.

  • Design and improve contract lifecycle and approval workflows, including integrations with CLM and e-signature platforms such as DocuSign or similar technologies.

  • Support workflows connecting commercial agreements to customer entitlements and provisioning, including centralized entitlement management platforms such as Stig or similar technologies.

  • Understand and improve data integrations across the revenue technology ecosystem, including how GTM data moves between Salesforce, data lakehouse environments, Workday and other financial or operational systems through invoicing.

  • Champion an AI First approach by identifying manual or inefficient GTM processes and designing, building, and deploying AI-enabled workflows, automations, and agentic systems that improve execution quality and scalability.

  • Evaluate the GTM technology ecosystem and emerging AI-native platforms, identifying opportunities to simplify architecture, automate workflows, improve data quality, and increase operational leverage.

  • Establish governance standards, shared definitions, system-of-record integrity, and operational best practices that improve consistency and reliability across GTM systems.

  • Design system instrumentation and feedback loops that improve forecasting accuracy, pipeline visibility, data quality, and operational performance.

  • Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations teams operating within structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, ensuring systems and workflows reinforce effective opportunity management and forecasting practices.

  • Communicate technical concepts, process trade-offs, system constraints, and solution recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Systems, Sales Systems, GTM Systems, Business Systems, Revenue Operations, or a closely related role within a B2B SaaS or technology organization.

  • Deep hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a complex B2B sales environment, including building Salesforce Flows, creating and managing fields and objects, configuring validation and approval processes, and maintaining system and data integrity.

  • Strong understanding of downstream sales and revenue processes, including opportunity management, pipeline management, forecasting, quoting, approvals, contracting, and the progression of a deal from opportunity through invoicing.

  • Experience working with CPQ or comparable quoting systems, with the ability to understand and improve quoting workflows and partner effectively with developers or specialists on more complex configuration.

  • Experience designing or supporting approval workflows and contract lifecycle processes, including CLM, e-signature, or related systems.

  • Demonstrated understanding of systems integrations and data flows across CRM, data platforms, financial systems, and other components of a modern revenue technology stack.

  • Production experience deploying AI-enabled workflows or automations. Candidates should be able to clearly explain a manual or operational process they transformed using AI, how the solution was deployed, and the measurable business outcome it produced.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose ambiguous or complex operational problems, design scalable solutions, and make thoughtful trade-offs between business requirements, process design, and technical architecture.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and explain system architecture and trade-offs to stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce forecasting and territory management.

  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or comparable configure-price-quote technologies.

  • Experience with DocuSign, DocuSign CLM, or comparable contract lifecycle management and e-signature platforms.

  • Familiarity with centralized entitlement management platforms, such as Stig, and the relationship between commercial agreements, product entitlements, and customer provisioning.

  • Experience integrating Salesforce with data lakehouse architectures, Workday, ERP, billing, or invoicing systems.

  • Experience working within a MEDDIC or MEDDPICC sales methodology and understanding how opportunity management processes and CRM design support the methodology.

  • Experience designing or deploying agentic AI workflows, AI-enabled operational tooling, or intelligent automation across Sales or Revenue Operations.

  • Experience working with complex pricing, packaging, or consumption/credit-based commercial models.

  • Experience scaling revenue systems within cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, AI-native, or high-growth technology organizations.

  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, operational standards, and scalable systems across multiple GTM functions.

Tier A: $175k - $190k

Tier B: $160 - $175k

jobs.description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora is the leader in monetization for subscription and usage-based businesses. On our strategic customer team, Solutions Engineers partner with Account Executives to win technical decisions on enterprise deals — and stay close to customers after the sale for adoption and expansion.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll design, build and demo solutions, run POCs when the deal requires it (APIs, data, integrations), and remain close to customers post sale in a strategic capacity.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with AEs on enterprise sales cycles: discovery, solution design, demos, and technical wins
  • Scope quote-to-cash solutions across billing, CPQ, and revenue — including subscription and usage-based pricing where relevant
  • Build tailored demos and proofs of concept aligned to customer requirements
  • Present to technical and business stakeholders, including senior leadership
  • Support technical health on assigned accounts and surface expansion opportunities
  • Collaborate with Product, Services, Support, and partners; contribute to RFPs and customer events as needed
  • Travel within your territory when required


About You

Required

  • 5+ years in Sales Engineering, Presales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Architecture on enterprise B2B SaaS deals
  • Demonstrated hands-on technical aptitude — you can configure, integrate, and build (not demo-only)
  • Experience in at least one of: billing/subscription platforms, quote-to-cash, ERP/finance systems, or revenue operations — Zuora experience not required
  • Strong communication with engineers, finance, and business buyers

Preferred

  • Usage-based or consumption billing (metering, rating, mediation)
  • Telecom or other high-volume usage models
  • AI or usage-heavy product monetization
  • Structured deal methodology (e.g. MEDDIC)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

About the Team

You will be part of a team focused on winning and expanding complex enterprise quote-to-cash opportunities by combining technical depth, business acumen, and customer partnership.

This team works closely across Account Executives, Product, Solutions, partners, and customer stakeholders to:

  • Solve complex monetization and billing challenges
  • Deliver tailored technical strategies, demos, and proofs of concept
  • Support customers from pre-sales through post-sale technical health and adoption
  • Surface customer insight that shapes roadmap and solution direction
  • Help customers scale modern consumption and AI-native business models

This is a highly collaborative environment for someone who wants to go beyond standard demos and play a meaningful role in shaping solution architecture, customer outcomes, and long-term growth.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth

jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

The Solutions Team are technical experts that work directly with customers and partners to provide world-class product, sales, industry, and domain expertise. Through deep customer/partner and product understanding, Partner Consultants are trusted advisors externally, and able to positively influence the product roadmap internally. Partner Consultants support Ramp’s Partner Managers across our diverse channel ecosystem — including accounting firms, value-added resellers, private equity firms, and more — by delivering deep product expertise and workflow advisement to partners and their clients. PCs build partner competency, guide best-practice adoption, and strengthen partner trust in Ramp’s capabilities to help them drive meaningful outcomes for the businesses they serve.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Channel, Partnerships, Sales, Product and Partner Firms to advocate for product & integration development in-line with customer needs

  • Collaborate with Ramp Channel Partner Managers to showcase technical accounting features and benefits through customized product demos, workflow illustrations, and enablement creation to onboard and train Ramp's partners

  • Help partners build service packages targeted at Ramp customers and identify opportunities for client-advisory services or managed-services. Develop product solutions based on a deep understanding of integration and configuration options, ensuring effective alignment with customer needs

  • Architect, advise on, and validate custom API-based integrations between Ramp and third-party platforms — supporting partners in the design, build, and testing of reliable, scalable integrations.

  • Support Sales and Post-Sales teams in executing advanced technical and accounting implementations for Ramp in conjunction with Channel partners

  • Evaluate customer requirements for new partner opportunities, determining Ramp's suitability through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical evaluations during customer discovery

  • Work alongside Channel, Product, Product Marketing, and Product Operations to create and maintain technical assets and an internal knowledge base of customer use cases and best practices

  • 6+ years of experience in Partner Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or similar customer-facing roles, focusing on implementing business SaaS solutions

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, finance, accounting or related field

  • Strong communication skills: able to translate complex technical solutions into business value, guide customers toward scalable approaches, and diplomatically steer conversations when requests are misaligned with best practices or product capabilities

  • Experience in channel sales, working with SIs & ISVs highly desired

jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Vice President, Go-To-Market (GTM) Operations

Remote Location: Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC

Position Summary

HackerOne, a global leader in security solutions, is transforming into an AI-native, product-driven company — and our go-to-market engine must evolve accordingly. We are seeking a strategic and systems-oriented VP of Go-to-Market Operations to lead the transformation and build of a modern, intelligence-powered revenue organization.

The Vice President Go-to-Market Operations will architect the operating system that powers HackerOne transformation - connecting strategy, data, AI, and execution to create a predictable, scalable, and efficient revenue engine. Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, Commissions, Revenue Enablement, and GTM Systems functions are within the scope of the VP. Reporting to the CEO, and as a key member of the Revenue Leadership Team, you will be responsible for building an AI-first operating infrastructure that connects strategy to execution through data, automation, and predictive insight.

You will move the organization from reactive reporting to real-time revenue intelligence — embedding AI into forecasting, territory design, pipeline management, and productivity optimization. The ideal candidate has led organizational transformation at scale and designed systems that create durable operating leverage high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity environments.

This is not simply a process optimization role — it is a mandate to reimagine how revenue teams operate in an AI-native enterprise.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

What You Will Do

Architect an AI-Native Revenue Operating Model

Design and implement a scalable, AI-enabled GTM operating framework that transforms out GTM motion and drives predictable growth.

  • Institutionalize AI-driven workflows across pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, and customer lifecycle orchestration

  • Embed automation and intelligence into systems, dashboards, and daily operating rhythms

  • Establish global standards for data hygiene, tooling adoption, and workflow consistency

  • Build the infrastructure to enable a global enterprise focused revenue organization in a product value and data-centric motion

Transformational Leadership & Planning

  • Lead transformation initiatives around revenue planning, pricing, process improvement and enablement across the organization

  • Partner with Finance and Revenue leadership to drive long-range and annual planning, including quota design, territory alignment, capacity modeling, and incentive optimization

  • Translate corporate strategy into measurable GTM execution plans

  • Work with product leadership to operationalize pricing and packaging and enablement to support evolving product strategy and optimize revenue performance

  • Design commission and incentive structures that reward value creation, product adoption, and long-term customer success

Revenue Intelligence & Predictive Analytics

Elevate Revenue Operations into a forward-looking intelligence engine:

  • Implement predictive forecasting models leveraging AI and advanced analytics

  • Build executive-level dashboards that connect pipeline health, win rates, sales velocity, CAC, LTV, and retention to strategic outcomes

  • Drive scenario planning and sensitivity modeling to inform strategic decisions

  • Establish leading indicators for growth, churn risk, and expansion opportunities

  • Institutionalize data-driven insights and decision-making across Sales, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing

Operational Excellence & Systems Architecture

  • Own the GTM systems roadmap (CRM, analytics platforms, AI tooling)

  • Modernize and integrate revenue tech stack for scalability, interoperability, and automation

  • Optimize end-to-end revenue processes to reduce friction and increase productivity

  • Ensure operational readiness for strategic initiatives including new product launches, pricing changes, and international expansion

  • Drive operational rigor in forecasting cadence, QBRs, and weekly revenue rhythms

Revenue Enablement & Productivity

  • Lead cross-functional enablement execution with Sales, PMM, and Product to align enablement initiatives with product strategy and market positioning

  • Institutionalize a data-informed enablement roadmap tied to measurable productivity outcomes

  • Ensure sales methodology and value-based selling frameworks are reinforced through analytics and coaching tools

  • Develop performance scorecards that empower frontline leaders with actionable insights

Outcomes & Impact

Success in this role will be defined by:

  • Revenue forecast accuracy ±5%

  • Higher ARR per seller/ Improved pipeline conversion

  • Shorter, more efficient sales cycles

  • Increased pipeline conversion and improved retention/expansion rates

  • A single executive revenue dashboard used consistently by the ELT and Board

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in strategic and revenue operations, including 5+ years leading Global GTM Operations

  • Proven experience scaling GTM operations in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies

  • Demonstrated success modernizing revenue tech stacks and embedding AI or advanced analytics into GTM workflows

  • Domain knowledge in revenue operations, GTM strategy, marketing operations, and incentive design

  • Strong financial acumen with experience in capacity modeling, forecasting, and IPO readiness

  • Exceptional analytical rigor with ability to translate complex data into strategic insight

  • Exceptional first-principles problem-solving

  • Executive presence and experience influencing C-level and Board stakeholders

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating in AI-native or product-led growth environments

  • Experience building predictive revenue analytics and AI-enabled forecasting models

  • Experience leading global GTM teams across multiple regions

  • Experience preparing revenue infrastructure for IPO or public company scale

(#LI-IJ)

Job Benefits:

  • Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*

  • Equity stock options

  • Retirement plans

  • Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO

  • Paid maternity and parental leave

  • Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

  • Employee Assistance Program

*Eligibility may differ by country

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager, Supplier Network Growth

Location: Remote - Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, Thailand

About Worldly

Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.

Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.

Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story.

About The Role

This role sits at the center of Worldly's supplier side business, in the region where most of the network actually lives. East and Southeast Asia is home to tens of thousands of the manufacturers on the Worldly platform. How well we reach them, how easy we make it to join and get value, and how clearly we tell them what's in it for them, all of that runs through this seat.

You'll own the marketing that helps suppliers find Worldly, buy in, get onboarded, and stay. You'll make the global message land in local markets. And you'll be the person making sure the supplier voice shows up in how we position, build, and sell. The supplier purchase experience is a direct revenue driver, so the words, the flow, and the in-product messaging all move the numbers.

You'll report to the Senior Director, Product Marketing and work shoulder to shoulder with the Regional Supplier Engagement and Lifecycle teams in Hong Kong.

What You'll Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for the global supplier audience: the factories, manufacturers, vendors, and others who buy and complete assessments on Worldly.

  • Drive the supplier purchase and onboarding experience. Suppliers buy through Worldly directly, so you'll help reduce friction and lift the rate at which they find us, buy, and finish their first assessment.

  • Make the value obvious and specific. One assessment that satisfies many brand customers. Less time lost to repeat audits. A path to win new business with the 350+ buyers already on the network. Your job is to make that real, not abstract.

  • Adapt the global message for local markets. Translate, localize, and reshape so it's culturally relevant and lands the way it should across the region's biggest supplier markets.

  • Produce supplier content and enablement at volume using AI-assisted workflows. Onboarding emails, success stories, assessment guidance, in-product copy, partner materials. You'll build and run these workflows yourself, not wait in a queue.

  • Bring the region back to the team. Stay close to suppliers and the people who serve them, and feed what you learn into positioning, our buyer intelligence practice, and the product roadmap.

  • Partner across functions and time zones with Regional Supplier Engagement, Lifecycle, Demand Generation, Growth, and Product.

  • Support association and partner co-marketing in region, including work with the industry bodies that shape how suppliers think about assessments and standards.

We'd Like to See

  • Minimum 6 years in product marketing or an adjacent go-to-market role (content, demand, lifecycle, partner, or community marketing) in B2B SaaS, B2B ecommerce, or a related industry.

  • Experience in consumer goods supply chains, and manufacturing.

  • Proven track record of directly increasing revenue and ecommerce sales with marketing programs that target business customers.

  • Experience serving as a strategic voice of the customer within product development cycles — influencing roadmap decisions, feature prioritization, and go-to-market strategy

  • Fluent in English plus at least one relevant regional language.

  • A strong writer and editor in English and one additional regional language who can take technical, regulatory, or data-heavy material and make it clear, useful, and human.

  • Comfortable with data. You can read it, question it, and turn it into a story and an argument.

  • AI-fluent, or hungry to be. You already build AI-assisted workflows for research, drafting, and enablement, or you're eager to learn fast. This is how the team works, not a side experiment.

  • A real collaborator who works well across functions, cultures, and time zones.

It Helps If You Have

  • Localization or multi-market marketing experience.

  • eCommerce or self-serve purchase experience.

  • Mandarin is a strong plus given how much of our supplier network is in China.

Why This Role

You'll own a motion that's core to the business, in the region where the network lives. You'll have real scope, not a narrow lane. And you'll help build an AI-native way of working on a team that's actively reinventing how marketing operates. If you want work that shows up in the numbers and shapes how a category leader grows, this is it.

What We Can Offer You

  • Comprehensive benefits offerings. 100% employee premium covered by Worldly.

  • Growth Opportunities

  • Equipment Stipends

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Paid company holidays

Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

  • Use the office stipend to get the supplies you need. Combat zoom fatigue with no-meeting Fridays.

  • Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves.

  • We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups.

Equity Statement

We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

jobs.description:
Corporate Tax Lead

Take a look inside our Sofia office

About the team

SumUp's European Tax team is responsible for corporate income tax and transfer pricing compliance across 35+ entities — a function that sits at the heart of the company's financial integrity and growth. As SumUp moves into a tax-payable position and prepares for the next stage of its journey, the direct tax domain has never been more critical or more visible. This role is the primary owner of that domain: you'll design the compliance framework, ensure every filing is accurate and on time, and build the controls infrastructure that underpins sound tax governance. If you're looking for a role where your technical expertise has real, measurable impact, and where you can shape a function rather than just maintain one, this is it.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end Corporate Income Tax compliance across all European entities and Australia, including filing design, instalment calculations, deadline management, and audit-ready documentation

  • Lead the remediation of outstanding direct tax compliance items, building a structured backlog register with risk ratings and a clear remediation plan

  • Establish and maintain a 4-eyes quality control framework across all CIT, withholding tax, Pillar 2, and Country-by-Country Reporting filings

  • Build and maintain a master compliance calendar with jurisdiction-specific workflows, ensuring the compliance cycle runs predictably and without last-minute escalations

  • Advise on complex direct tax matters — including transfer pricing, M&A activity, and restructuring — and act as the primary point of contact for Finance, Accounting, and Controlling teams

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Strong, hands-on experience in corporate income tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions in a multinational environment, gained both in-house and in an advisory capacity

  • Deep knowledge of CIT mechanics, withholding tax obligations, and a solid working understanding of Pillar 2 / GloBE rules and Country-by-Country Reporting

  • Ability to read, challenge, and discuss financial statements independently, with a strong accounting foundation and familiarity with the interaction between management accounts and statutory accounts

  • Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, Power Query) and strong ERP experience, preferably SAP

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, evolving environment where priorities shift and the ability to manage multiple jurisdictions simultaneously is essential

Why you should join SumUp

Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Options Programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education Generous time off: enjoy 20 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce.
